title: [SOLVED/CLOSED] High scores not working
body:
Specs
Moto G9 Power
LineageOS 22.1
Android 15

Info:
I take 2 or 3 seconds to complete the test but my highscore shows 82, 12 or 7 seconds. If needed i can upload a video playing with w/ a timer on screen.
author: artur15lima

comments.body: Hi, the timer starts the moment the numbers become visible on the screen, not after you press 1. Please confirm that this is how you're timing yourself too.
Ok, now i understand it. Tysm.

title: Makes noise when volume is off
body: Hey cool app! But it makes noise when I push the numbers when my volume is off, and there is no option to disable it.
author: Neriderc

comments.body:
Hi. We just released a new version with an option to turn sounds off. I think it's going to take around 48 hours to show up on F-Droid.

But I'm going to keep this issue open because the app should be using current system volume.
Awesome, I'll check it out again once it comes onto F-Droid 🙂

title: Option To Disable Sound
body: Can you add an option to disable the sounds in the app. The sounds are loud and distracting.
author: user44000

comments.body: Added. Should be available in the next release.
